content: OMB+ is a German e-learning platform that assists students who are preparing for an engineering or computer science study at a university. The central purpose of the course is to support students in reviving their mathematical skills so that they can follow the upcoming university courses. The platform is thematically segmented into 13 sections and includes free mathematical classes with theoretical and practical content. Besides that, OMB+ provides a possibility to get assistance from a human tutor via a chat interface. Usually, the students and tutors interact in written form, and the language of communication is German. The current problem of the OMB+ platform is that the number of students grows every year, but to hire more qualified human tutors is challenging and expensive. This results in a more extended waiting period for students until their problems can be considered.
